title: Flying Saucer presents 25th Anniversary Celebration
excerpt: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium will celebrate 25 years in San Antonio with an epic blowout. They will tap specialty brews, including Dogfish Head 120 Minute IPA, Dogfish Head World Wide Stout, Pinthouse Nomura Imperial Jellyfish IPA, Saint Arnold French Press, Real Ale Blakkr, and more.
content:
Photo courtesy of Flying Saucer

Flying Saucer Draught Emporium will celebrate 25 years in San Antonio with an epic blowout. They will tap specialty brews, including Dogfish Head 120 Minute IPA, Dogfish Head World Wide Stout, Pinthouse Nomura Imperial Jellyfish IPA, Saint Arnold French Press, Real Ale Blakkr, and more.

San Antonio singer/songwriter Matty Lee takes the stage with his signature reggae, rock and psychedelic sound from 6-9 pm. Guests are encouraged to dress as their favorite movie characters from 2001.
